name: Colorful Notes TinyGlow Annotator
author: cloudknight

sections.description:
Colorful Notes TinyGlow Annotator lets users highlight any text and attach color-coded notes directly to your content. Admins can respond to each annotation individually, keeping feedback organized and easy to follow. Ideal for collaborative writing, educational platforms, and community-driven engagement.

Features:

  • Multi-section text editor with independent styling
  • Text highlighting and note-taking
  • Admin can reply to user notes
  • Users can reply to admin responses
  • Color-coded notes for easy organization
  • Role-based permissions
  • Note length validation
  • Clean, modern interface

Pro Version Available:

Upgrade to Colorful Notes Pro for advanced features and premium support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/colorful-notes directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Colorful Notes menu to configure the plugin
  4. Add the Colorful Notes block to your posts or pages
sections.faq:
How many notes can a user create?

Users can create 1 note per page.

Can users see other users’ notes?

Yes, all notes are visible to all users.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes, you can customize the color palette in the settings.

What roles can create notes?

You can configure which user roles are allowed to create notes in the settings.
